tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i mngon rtogs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kun rang bzhin bdag gnyis med pa yi// dbyings dang ye shes kun du ro gcig kyang*// brtse bas sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul kun ston pa// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dkyil 'khor mchog de sgrub pa'i thabs// rgyal bu gser bzang gis bskul nas// lung dang man ngag ji bzhin du// bdag gis 'dir ni bshad par bya// yang dag dbang gis smin byas nas// dri ma med pa'i lung mnos la// dad brtse dam tshig mchog ldan pa'i// rnal 'byor pa yis rnal 'byor bsgom// bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi// brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa bsgom// spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas// spros pa nyid ni spros med byed// de la thog mar bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ stan bde ba la ci bde bar 'dug nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum skyabs su song ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje bdag med mar dmigs pa'i snying gi nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i oṃ sngon po las 'od 'phros pas rang gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ phyir 'phros pa'i snang bas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso mo'i dbur brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mos ni cang te'u rdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod// 'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces nang dang phyi dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mchod nas/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid snying po byang chub bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum gyis dam tshig dang sdom pa bzung ngo*// de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bde ba'i rgyu dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig de dag phan tshun chags pa dang sdang ba med par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pa las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du khro bo bcu gcig gi bdag nyid kyi srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya'o// de nas gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i lto ba yangs par/ e las gzhi'i yan lag chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs kha gyen du bstan pa'i nang du/ rgyu'i yan lag yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu zla gam/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu pa rnams la so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa rnams bskyed nas/ rkyen gyi yan lag rang gi shes pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho gnyis kyis mtha' brten par gyur pa dang 'dres pa las/

rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa dang lnga dang ldan pa/ mda' yab dang*/ drwa ba dang*/ drwa ba phyed pa dang*/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu la lha mo bcu drug gnas shing*/ pad+ma dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ gdugs dang bcas pa'i rta babs bzhi dang ldan zhing*/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dbus phyur bur phub pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa can gyi phyi'i khor yug tu/ shar du gtum drag lhor 'jigs byed thob pa can/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag tu dgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa mi bzad pa/ nub byang du ki li ki la'i sgra sgrogs pa'i dur khrod de dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag ni rim pa de nyid kyis/ brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pas rdo rje/ gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pas be con/ chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pas sbrul zhags/ gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pas dbyug to/ dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pas rtse gsum/ me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang dbyu gu gsum pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs/ srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pas ral gri/ rlung lha ljang sngon sha ba la zhon pas ba dan 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rig mas g.yon nas brten zhing spyi bos bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad dang*/ shi ri sha tsu ta/ kaṃ ka la/ a shwat+ṭha/ shing chen po/ ka rañdza/ 'khril shing can/ a rdzun ste shing brgyad/ de dag la brten pa'i lha'i dge 'dun/ gshin rje/ sprin gyi rgyal po/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon/ yi dwags 'dus pa/ drang srong 'dus pa/ srin po'i tshogs can/ rlung gi rgyal po ste/ phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi bzhon pa'i mgo brnyan can/

gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad/ nor rgyas/ pad+ma/ karko ṭa/ 'jog po/ pad+ma chen po/ hu lun+ta/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong rnams te/ klu chen po brgyad/ sgrogs byed/ ldog byed/ 'jigs pa/ 'khor byed/ mthug po/ 'gengs byed/ char 'bebs/ gtum po ste sprin brgyad/ gzhan yang mchod rten brgyad/ chu bo brgyad/ me brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gang ba/ ro dang*/ ro langs dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ sha za'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsam mo// nang gi lha snam phyogs mdog can gyi dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa nyis brtsegs kyi lte ba dang*/ nang gi phyogs bzhi dang*/ phyi'i 'dab ma brgyad dang*/ dbus kyi thad ka'i steng 'og ste gnas bco lngar nyi ma dang ro'i gdan dang*/ nang gi mtshams bzhir bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi bsgom mo// gdan rnams kyi steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥzhes pa phrag gnyis pa bco lnga las me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bco lnga'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis pa bco lnga las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bco lnga bsgoms pa'i bar du/ nang gi dbus dang shar nas rim pa bzhin/ aṃ āṃ/ iṃ īṃ/ uṃ dang phyi'i byang shar nas/ ūṃ ṛṃ ṝṃ/ l̥ṃ dang*/ shar nas/ l̥̄ṃ eṃ aiṃ/ oṃ dang*/ 'og dang steng du au dang*/ aṃ gi yi ge rnams las/ gri gug sngon po yu bar yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor bsgom zhing*/ gnas so sor nyi zla phyag mtshan dang bcas pa gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su dmigs nas/ de las lha mo'i sku bco lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus su rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/

rdo rje ma/ gsang ba'i dkar mo/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ste lnga dang*/ mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dang*/ phyi'i byang shar nas/ puk+ka sī/ ri khrod ma/ gdol pa mo/ g.yung mo dang*/ shar nas gau rī/ tsau rī/ be tā lī/ ghasma rī/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ steng du mkha' spyod ma rnams te/ lha mo thams cad kha dog gnag /drag chen phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// zhal gcig spyan gsum dmar ba rnams// lag par gri gug thod pas khyab// 'khor lo rna cha mgul rgyan dang*// lag gdub dang ni ska rags nyid// sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag pas// 'di rnams phyag rgya dag pa ste// ji ltar bdag med rnal 'byor ma// de ltar thams cad rnam par spyad// lag pa gcig ni thod pas brel// g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin// g.yon pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nyid do// stag gi pags pas snam dkris shing*// ro la zhon zhing gzi brjid 'bar// phyag gnyis gyen du dbu skyes ser// zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i tshul gyis ni// skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs// zhes bsgoms pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor dran par bya'o// de nas lha mo de rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngar bstan pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge rnams bsams pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros pas snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad sbyangs nas gzhal yas khang dpag tu med par gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas bcud kyi sems can thams cad sbyangs nas/ lha mo bco lnga'i tshogs dpag tu med par gyur pa rnams gzhal yas khang rnams su 'khod/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus pa rang rang la bstim mo// de nas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi mig tu mam̐ las gti mug rdo rje dkar mo/ rna bar ḍam̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje sngon mo/ snar pam̐ las ser sna rdo rje ser mo/ khar ram̐ las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar mo/

dpral bar am̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ljang gu/ snying gar nam̐ las bdag med rdo rje ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar mo/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje nag mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'i skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i am̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis gnas nas bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la lha mo brgyad kyis mchod nas/ 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas// bdag med rnal 'byor mar gyur gang*// phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub la// sgyu ma'i phyag rgyas phyag 'tshal 'dud// ces pas bstod la/ snying ga nas sprul pa'i gau rī la sogs pa rnams kyis dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du byas par bsam zhing phyag rgya dang bcas pas oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wa ti ma hā kā ru ṇi ka nai rāt+m+ya sa pa ri wā ra zhes kun la sbyar la gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ be tā lī ban+dha baṃ/ e h+ye hi mi sbyar bar ghasma rī ba shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes pas rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam mo// de nas yang rang gi snying ga'i aṃ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug rnams spyan drangs pa la/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rje bdag la stsol// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs// nga rgyal phrag dog chen po kun// rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mgon// las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa// rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod// ces pas bstod de/

bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur gsol// oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// zhes pa dang*/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu blang*/ byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa mdzad/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa// rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med// mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag par rnam par snang mdzad do// ska rags la ni don yod gnas// yan lag kun la rdo rje 'dzin// zhes rgyan drug gi dag pa dran par bya/ chu rgyun des mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo las kyi phyag rgya/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo phyag rgya chen po zhes 'khor lo bzhi'i dag pa dran par bya/ chu rgyun des snying ga yan chad gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa skye mched kyi dag pa dran par bya/ chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ bdag med ma la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ dkar mo la rin chen 'byung ldan/ chu ma la 'od dpag med/

mkha' 'gro ma la don yod grub pa/ gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha ba rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ be tā lī dang tsan+dā lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma rī dang*/ g.yung mo la 'od dpag med/ sa spyod ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' spyod ma la 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan nas/ dbang gi lha de rnams kyang rang la bstim par bya'o// de nas bdud rtsi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas rang gi lce la myangs pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad mnyes nas/ zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bdag yin snyam du bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod par bsam zhing*/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// la sogs pa brjod nas/ mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par bya ba'i ngo bo bdag yin snyam du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas lha mo de dag nyid kyis bstod par bsgom zhing*/ 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas// zhes pa la sogs pa brjod nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang bstod par bya ba yon tan gyi ngo bo bdag yin snyam du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ lha mo rnams rang gi snying gar bstim mo// de nas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang snod bcud kyi lha thams cad kyi sku mdog la dmigs te/ dang por nag po rab tu bsgom// gnyis par dmar po rnam par bsgom// gsum pa la ni ser por bsgom// bzhi par ljang gu de bzhin no// lnga par kha dog sngon po dang*// drug par dkar po'i lus can te// yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byor gyis// dga' bral mthar yang de bzhin no// zhes kha dog rnams bsgyur zhing bsgoms pas lha nyid la'ang zhen pa dang bral zhing ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor pa dang*/

de bzhin gshegs pa rigs drug gi byin rlabs 'jug cing*/ phrin las rnams thogs pa med par 'grub par 'gyur ro// slar yang rang bzhin gyi sku mdog nag po 'ba' zhig bsgoms la/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la dmigs pa gtad de sems mnyam par gzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul la gnyis las/ dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ lha bsdus nas rang nyid gtso mo rkyang du gnas pa'am/ ma bsdus kyang rung ste lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang ldan pas/ spyi gtsug nas lte ba'i bar du rtsa a wa dhū tī shin tu phra ba thig le'i dwangs mas gang ba/ de'i g.yas su ro ma me'i rang bzhin rak+tas gang ba dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma chu'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba dkar po/ a wa dhū tī la brten pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar/ a dmar po me'i rang bzhin mgo gyen du lta ba/ nang skor 'dab brgyad la/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha phyi skor la ā li phrag gnyis dang*/ ha dang k+ṣa spangs pa'i kā li/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar thig les gang ba'i hūm̐ nag po mgo thur du lta ba/ phyogs bzhir bh+rūm̐ āṃ dz+rī khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir laṃ maṃ paṃ tāṃ/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte bar/ a dmar po me'i rang bzhin mgo gyen du lta ba/ 'dab ma la ā li/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis pa'i lte bar thig les gang ba'i haṃ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/ 'dab ma la ā li phrag gnyis bsam/ de nas 'og gi rlung gis lte ba'i a cher sbar ba/ ro ma'i me dang 'grogs te/ gyen du cher 'bar bas 'khor lo gong ma gsum bsregs/ tshangs pa'i bu ga nas phyir song bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi long bu g.yas par zhugs nas/

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bkug pa tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ g.yon rkyang ma'i thig le dang bcas te bab/ rim pa bzhin 'khor lo rnams gsal btab/ thigs pa gcig lte ba'i a la phog pas/ de las me'i zer ma shin tu phra ba a wa dha tī'i nang nas myur du song bas/ spyi bo'i haṃ la bsnun pas/ haṃ las thig le'i dwangs ma shin tu phra ba'i rgyun dbu ma'i lam nas zags nas/ gtum mo'i me la zhugs pas me'i nus pa cher 'phel zhing*/ thig le lte ba nas 'phros pas lus thams cad la khyab pas bde ba skyes/ me'i nus pa khams dang 'dres pas spyi bo nas lus thams cad la khyab pas drod 'bar bar bsam zhing rlung kha sbyor du bya'o// de ltar goms pas lus la drod dang bde ba dang*/ sems la gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro// dmigs med bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ snying ga'i aṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ snod bcud thams cad srung ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu/ de gzhal yas khang*/ de phyi'i lha mo bcu la/ steng 'og gi lha mo gnyis gdan dang bcas pa/ gtso mo'i dbu dang*/ zhabs dang*/ phyogs mtshams kyi lha mo brgyad gdan dang bcas pa/ nang gi lha mo bzhi dang*/ thod pa rnams la/ de dag gdan dang bcas pa'ang gtso mo'i sku'i thad ka rnams su bsdu'o// gtso mo'ang thugs ka'i aṃ la bsdu/ aṃ gi khog pa mgo bo/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da la bsdu ste sems cung zad bzung ngo*// de nas nā da'ang yal te mi dmigs pa'i ngang la gzhag go /de goms pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// denas chu las chu bor rdol ba ltar/ 'od gsal las rang nyid zung 'jug gi sku rdo rje bdag med mar bzhengs pa/ de'i thugs ka'i am̐ las 'od 'phros pas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor snod bcud dang bcas pa sngar bzhin gsal btab nas/ rtsa ba'i lha mo rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

so so'i sa bon gyi yi ge gsal bar dmigs pa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sgrib pa gnyis sbyangs tshogs gnyis spel sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas de dag gi byin rlabs bdag la 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ām̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.im̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.īm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.um̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.ūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥṛ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥṝm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥl̥m̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥl̥̄m̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.em̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.aim̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.au+iṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa so so'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ phreng ba'i sngags rnams gang la mos pa ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla bar bya'o// bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// de ltar bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bya ba'i tshul ni/ dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal khru gang ba la ba byung dang dri bzang gis byug chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ nang mchod dang*/ rdo rje dril bu rnams ji ltar rigs par bzhag rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams bsdus te/ gtso mo'am he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas te/ yo byad rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dha3haṃ gis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas gyi mchod pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che bar bskyed la/ so so'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dri'i chu blugs pa lag pa g.yas pas dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du byug cing*/

srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa skad cig gis bskyed/ lha dang ka pā la'i gnas rnams su dri'i thig le dang me tog tshom bu cung zad re bzhag pa gdan rnams su bsgoms nas/ dbus su me tog gi tshom bu dgod cing*/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ badz+ra nai rāt+mā na maḥ zhes pas rdo rje bdag med ma dang*/ shar du oṃ āḥ.ām̐ badz+rī ye na mas rdo rje ma/ lhor oṃ āḥ.iṃ gau rī ye na mas dkar mo/ nub tu oṃ āḥ.īṃ wa rī ye na mas chu ma/ byang du oṃ āḥ.uṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye na mas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ mtshams rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ las bdud rtsi gang ba'i thod pa/ phyi'i byang shar du/ oṃ āḥ.ūṃ puk+ka sī ye na mas puk+ka sī/ shar lhor oṃ āḥṛṃ sha ba rī ye na mas ri khrod ma/ lho nub du/ oṃ āḥṝ tsaṇ+ḍā lī ye na mas gdol pa mo/ nub byang du oṃ āḥl̥ṃ ḍoṃ bi nī ye na mas g.yung mo/ shar du oṃ āḥl̥̄ṃ gau rī ye na mas gau rī/ lhor oṃ āḥ.em̐ tsau rī ye na mas chom rkun ma/ nub tu oṃ āḥ.aiṃ be tā lī ye na mas ro langs ma/ byang du oṃ āḥ.oṃ ghasma rī ye na mas ghasma rī/ 'og tu bsgom par bya ba nub tu/ oṃ āḥ.auṃ bhu tsa rī ye na mas sa spyod ma/ steng du bsgom par bya ba shar du/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ khe tsa rī ye na mas mkha' spyod ma rnams bskyed/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi lag pa g.yas pa hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ g.yon pa a las pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa as mtshan par bskyed la/ hūm̐ a zhes brjod pas/ de dag zhu ba las byung ba'i lag par byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ g.yas pas rdo rje smin mtshams kyi bar du lan gsum gsor nas snying gar bzung la hūm̐ zhes brjod de/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems thugs kyi dam tshig oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/

g.yon pas dril bu dkrol nas kha gyen du bstan te/ dkur bzung la/ aḥzhes brjod nas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa ston par byed pa gsung gi dam tshig de ltar rang lha'i skur dmigs pa phyag rgya'i dam tshig tu dran par bya ba ste dam tshig gsum gyis bdag byin gyis brlab/ dril bu gnas brgyad du dkrol ba'i sgras/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drang bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pra dz+ny+yā pā ra mi tā/ nā da swa bha we/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ a khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wa ti ma hā kā ru ṇi ka nai rāt+mā sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod cing*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la/ mchod cing bstod nas/ bstim pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar byas nas/ bla ma dang rigs bdag gnyis su med par blta'o// sgrub pa'o// de nas so so'i phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ bha ga wa ti ma hā kā ru ṇi ka nai rāt+mā sa pa ri wā ra ni ri te āḥhūm̐ gis zhabs bsil dbul/ de bzhin du zhal bsil 'di dang*/ ni wi ti āḥhūm̐ 'thor 'thung 'di dang*/ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ mchod yon 'di dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥm hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon rnams dbul lo// me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang*// gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog

/bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la// dge zhing mun pa rnams sel ba// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// badz+ra dharma zhes pa nas a khaṃ swā hā'i bar gong du bstan pa ltar brjod la rol mo dbul lo// phyi'i mchod pa'o// nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ mtheb srin gyis gtor ba rnams thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba du mar gyur pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ yi dam gyi lha rnams la so so'i sngags kyis phul la/ lce dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su reg pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod/ de nas chos skyong srung ma dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams dang*/ mthar rig drug gi sems can rnams la byin pas tshim par bsam mo// nang gi mchod pa'o// snying ga nas sprul pa'i gau rī la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// zhes pa la sogs pas mchod pa ni yid las byung ba'o// rang gi lus dpag tu med pa sprul pas bstod cing phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhing*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// la sogs pas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/

sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la ci shes pas bstod par bya'o// bstod pa'i mchod pa'o// de nas sdig pa dang nyes ltung 'dag cing tshogs 'dums par bya ba'i phyir/ yan lag bdun pa dang sdom pa gzung ba lan gsum gsum du byas nas/ las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /ces pa dang*/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol gyur ba// des ni sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces smon lam btab bo// de nas mngon par bshams pa'i gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ āḥlas thod par/ shar nas rim pas/ go las ba lang gi sha ku las khyi'i sha da las rta'i sha ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de'i steng du rim pa des bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/ ām̐ḥlas rak+ta/ dz+rīṃ las byang chub kyi sems/ khaṃ las klad pa/ hūm̐ las dri chu/ de'i steng du rim pa des/ bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu/ ām̐ mnyam pa nyid/ dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa/ kham̐ bya ba grub pa/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng du bdud rtsi'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/ de'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de thams cad kyi g.yon skor du ā li/ g.yas skor du kā lis bskor bar bsam mo// hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ des me sbar bas rdzas thams cad zhu/ rlangs pa oṃ la phog pas bdud rtsis rgyun bab/ hūm̐ la phog pas/ de las kyang 'od zer 'phros pas brtan g.yo'i bcud dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par bkug pa rdo rje la thim/

rdo rje nyi ma dang oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung nas thams cad 'dres te/ kha dog dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsir bskyed nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlab pa rdzas kyi ting nge 'dzin to// mdun gyi nam mkhar e las chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs kyi dbus ma'i lte bar bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ steng gi lte ba dang 'dab mar oṃ rnams las dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar nas rim pas dbang phyug chen po/ lha'i dbang po/ tshangs pa chen po/ khyab 'jug shar lho nas 'dod pas dbang phyug tshogs kyi bdag po/ bhṛṅgi ri ti/ gzhon nu kārti kā/ thams cad mdog dkar po/ bar gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ hūm̐ brgyad las/ brgya byin/ gshin rje/ chu lha/ gnod sbyin/ me lha/ srin po/ rlung lha/ dbang ldan te thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po'o// 'og gi lte ba dang 'dab mar āḥrnams las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ 'dab ma rnams la stobs kyi rgyu/ dung skyong*/ mtha' yas/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ rigs ldan/ pad+ma/ pad+ma chen po ste thams cad sku mdog dmar po/ lha thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum la gnyis su med par 'khyud pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsam mo// de nas gtso bo gsum kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i sems can thams cad rang rang gi 'khor rnams la bsdus nas/ thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs pa la/ mchod cing gsol ba btab/ dbang bskur bas/ sku rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ gsung rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med/

phyogs skyong rnams la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam pa ni mgron gyi ting nge 'dzin no// lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba'i nang nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ bha ga wa ti ma hā kā ru ṇi ka nai rāt+mā sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wāk+tsīt+ta/ in+da/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+kha/ bhū ta/ bah+ni/ bā u/ rak+kha/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā da/ pap+pa/ ta la/ pā tā le/ aṭ+ṭa sap+pa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhūp+pa/ maṃ sa/ piṃ gha/ am+bha/ sap+pa/ kadz+dza/ sā da/ khan+ti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ phyi nang yid las byung bas mchod/ snga ma bzhin bstod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus mi 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces phrin las gzhol nas/ kol+la i reṭaṭhi a bo lā/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā/ gha ṇe kṛ pi ṭa ho bādz+dzā i/ ka ru ṇe ki a i na ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza ī/ gā ḍheṃ ma a ṇī pīdz+dzā i/ ha le kā liñdza ra pa ṇi a i/ dun+du ra bādz+dzi a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu rī sih+lā/ kā pū ra lā i a i/ mā la in+dha naṃ sā liñdza/ ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i/ phreṃ kha ḍa kha ṭa ka ran+te shud+dha a shud+dha na mu ni a i/ ni rāṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍā wi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun tu ru b+ba ṭā i/ ḍi ṇi ma ta hin+na bādz+dzi a i/ zhes rdo rje'i glus byin dbab/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod do// de nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gtor ma'i mgron gnyis ka la rang gis nongs par spyad pa bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pas cho ga lhag chad kha bskang*/ smon lam gdab/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gnyis ka gshegs su gsol lo// dam tshig pa rnams bdag la bsdu'o// mchod pa dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// kha zas gtor ma ltar ram/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ rang rdo rje bdag med mar dmigs pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod du/

snying gar lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ bla ma gtso mo'i rigs bdag tu bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba/ lte bar chos skyong srung ma dang*/ 'byung po nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sems can thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyis kha me'i sgor bsreg blugs kyi tshul du phul bas/ thams cad mchod par bsam zhing bza'o// lhag ma/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hās/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin no// kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal bar dmigs nas/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te// tshor ba la ni dkar mor brjod// 'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma// 'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni// bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so// zhe sdang zhes bshad rdo rje ma// 'dod chags chu yi rnal 'byor ma// ser sna gsang ba'i dkar mo nyid// gti mug de bzhin rdo rjer bshad// sa ni puk+ka sīr bshad de// chu khams rngon pa mo zhes bshad// me ni gtum mor shes par bya// rlung gi g.yung mor rab tu grags// gzugs la dkar mor rtag tu bshad// sgra la chom rkun ma rab grags// dri yi cha la ro langs ma// ro la ghasma rī rab grags// reg la sa spyod ma zhes brjod// chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma// zhes lha'i dag pa dang*/ nga rgyal la sogs skyon drug rnams// gcod phyir gri gug rnam par gnas// dngos dang dngos min rnam rtog gi /mgo bo pad+ma'i snod du ni// bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag /dngos grub phyir ni btung bar bya// stong pa'irnam pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /thabs kyi ro ni rnam par brtag /spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa// rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med// mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag

/lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod// ska rags la ni don yod gnas// yan lag kun la rdo rje 'dzin// zhes phyag mtshan dang rgyan gyi dag pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa lam gyi chos rnam par dag pa/ dur khrod ni lus dang 'khor ba'i chos rnam par dag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas mthu stobs rnam par dag pa'o// zhes rten gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dran par byas nas/ 'khor gyi lha rnams rang la bsdu/ rang gi skye mched drug dang*/ yul gyi skye mched drug snga ma ltar lha rnams su dmigs nas/ yul gyi lhas nang gi lha la mchod par bsam zhing yul rnams la sdang zhen med par longs spyad do// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// rjes su chags pa'i rnam 'byor ni/ dbang gis smin pa'i yul la rung gi gzhan du na nyes par 'gyur ro// de yang*/ rang nyid he ru kar byas shing*// rang gi btsun mo ngar byas nas// chags can gyis ni 'dod spyod pa// de la nga ni rtag tu dgyes// zhes 'byung bas/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par gnas bsgyur/ rig ma rdo rje bdag med mar dmigs pa lha'i 'du shes/ gnyis ka'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang mkha' dang gsang ba pad+ma dang rdo rje a dang hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su khā dhā ra/ ma hā rā ka su khan+dā da tsa tu rā nan+da/ bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me zhes pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwe ṣa/ tsa tu rā nan+da dā ya kaḥkha ga mu kha e kā ra so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yāṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab pa sngags kyi 'du shes phyi nang gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs thams cad mchod par bya snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes dang ldan pas snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bde bas/ phyi nang gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod par bsam zhing*/ bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go

/rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ro// nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ gong du bshad pa'i dmigs med rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang 'dra'o// ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ de nyid las zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs pa dang 'dra'o// khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang bzhin gyis nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bkrus par bsam zhing yi ge brgya pa brjod bzhin pas khrus bya'o// khrus kyi rnal 'byor te/ yan lag gi rnal 'byor brgyad do// dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas de ltar rtag tu rnal 'byor du byed pas ni/ sa dang lam rnams myur du bgrod nas/ ring por mi thogs par rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// gsung rab zab mo'i snying po legs bsdus nas// nyams su blang ba'i tshul 'di jim gyin gyis// bskul nas 'phags pas sbyar ba'i dge ba yis// bdag gzhan ye shes mkha' 'gro nyid gyur cig /slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pa'i man ngag gi rjes su 'brang ba/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni/ dad pa dang shes rab kyi thugs yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa rgyal bu jim gyin gyis bskul nas/ dge slong sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ chu mo bya'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i yar gyi ngo la shing kun tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
